import asyncio
import httpx
async def app(scope, receive, send):
    raise RuntimeError('local sentinel')
async def check():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)) as client:
        try:
            await client.get('http://example.invalid/')
        except RuntimeError as error:
            assert str(error) == 'local sentinel'
        else:
            raise AssertionError('application error was suppressed')
asyncio.run(check())
